changes: Added coordinated palettes for all 41 monthly and event themes, including distinct hardware colors that remain active while keys are pressed or Shuffle is enabled.
Redrew the cassette in approved slate-blue and silver materials, with integrated metal fasteners, muted lilac reel rings and an orange side switch; retained the approved black pixel symbols.
Matched keycaps and inactive mode indicators to the new artwork grid, removed stale whole-device sprite backgrounds and kept pressed controls inside their original bounds.
Added larger event stickers with varied central, left-edge and upper-left placements; cleaned neighboring atlas fragments and gave May, February, Movie Night and Hidden Gems distinct artwork.
Cassette titles show playlist and song together, scroll with a two-second pause per loop, and keep the timer on a separate fixed row.
Restored original Press Start timing using drawn off textures; clipped the counter scan inside its frame and placed Press Start before On Air.
Birthday collections contain only saved favorites and update immediately without fixed fallback games.
The event list starts collapsed while all twelve calendar months remain independently visible; the music library has compact pixel controls.
Rebuilt the CRT television as one texture with crochet lace, a silver rabbit-ear antenna, a larger screen and a restyled game label below it.
Reorganized Player Profile metrics and library settings while preserving existing actions and personal data.

Aligned all 48 frame definitions to integer cuts, normalized four non-grid source dimensions, prevented legacy dimensions from overwriting current ones and redrew Christmas rails without burgundy bands.
Seasonal back-to-top skins recolor the original bitmap without changing its shape or responsive dimensions.
Refined the TV label inset with a local pixel font and centered pixel close icon; removed the two decorative yellow knob indicators.
Covered complete cassette key bevels and rebuilt the full three-slot indicator strip from the current case crop. Movie Night now uses all safe sticker zones.
Centered cassette glyphs in Full and Mini, including pause and latched Shuffle, without moving or enlarging the keys.
Added an illustrated pixel catalog console, matching Reset filters and By calendar buttons, and a compact neutral collection picker.
Seasonal scrollbars reveal only while in use; removed the redundant home recommendation caption and fixed both home preview cards to the same cover geometry.
Removed transparent margins from Back to top, matched its clickable pixel outline and fixed a shared 48×46 size in every theme and viewport without pressed movement.
